mation upon which such recommenda­
tion and reports are based, together with  
such other information as the Secretary  
may request.

paragraph shall not be applicable to  
grapes which have been shipped in rail­
road cars at a time when a regulation  
period established pursuant to paragraph 
(c) of this section is not in effect.

lished pursuant to this section, each

Committee any of the following informa­

grapes loaded in railroad cars for ship­

the date of the bill of lading covering

quantity of grapes loaded in a conveyance

livered to assembly points; and (4) the  
time of delivery of each carload of grapes  
at any assembly point.

tinued shipment shall be in the same or­
der that such grapes were placed, in

leased that day, less the quantity eligible
